headline: Arsenal to contact Pro Ref over Sunderland penalty incident - source
description: Arsenal will contact Pro Ref, the body in charge of officiating in English football, over the decision to award Sunderland a penalty in Saturday's Premier League match at the Stadium of Light, a source has told ESPN.

headline: Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola calls for help from forwards: 'Need to recover the ball as high as possible'
description: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola has called for his forward line to provide more support for the players behind them amid criticism of his team's midfield.

headline: Michael Carrick calls on Man United squad to 'move on' after derby loss, Erling Haaland goal 'injustice'
description: Michael Carrick has told his Manchester United players to put their derby disappointment behind them quickly despite feeling frustration that Erling Haaland's winner was allowed to stand.

headline: Manchester derby mess shows VAR's quest for perfection is doomed to fail
description: Erling Haaland's goal in the Manchester derby proved that perfection will always be out of reach for VAR, despite it being there to give us exactly that.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal keeping tabs on Liverpool teen Ngumoha
description: Arsenal are watching developments between Liverpool and Rio Ngumoha with interest. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Former West Ham goalkeeper Luděk Mikloško dies at 64 after cancer diagnosis
description: Former West Ham goalkeeper Luděk Mikloško has died aged 64 following a battle with cancer.
